# anthropic_rbac_roles (Data Source)

Lists RBAC roles in a Claude Enterprise organization. Roles are read-only through the API. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_roles" "all" {}

output "role_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_rbac_roles.all.roles[*].name
}
```
